# Learn Pretext

> An interactive learning site for @chenglou/pretext (pretext.js) — a zero-dependency JavaScript library for multiline text measurement and layout without DOM reflow. 26 pages of live demos, tutorials, and reference docs, each with annotated source code.

## About

Learn Pretext (https://learn-pretext.com) is an independent educational resource built by En Dash Consulting (https://endash.us). It teaches developers how to use the pretext library through interactive demos with annotated source code.

Pretext is a library by Cheng Lou (https://github.com/chenglou/pretext) that computes multiline text line breaks, heights, and widths using pure arithmetic over cached glyph widths — no DOM reads, no layout thrashing, hundreds of times faster than `getBoundingClientRect()`.

Note: this pretext is unrelated to PreTeXt, the XML markup language for authoring math textbooks. This site covers only the JavaScript text measurement library.

This site is NOT an official project of Cheng Lou or the pretext library.

## Key pretext concepts

- `prepare(text, font)` — one-time measurement pass, caches glyph widths (~0.1ms)
- `layout(prepared, maxWidth, lineHeight)` — pure arithmetic layout, returns lineCount + height (~0.005ms)
- `prepareWithSegments()` — like prepare but exposes segment data (text, widths, break kinds)
- `layoutWithLines()` — returns array of LayoutLine objects with per-line text and width
- `layoutNextLine()` — iterator-style, one line at a time with variable maxWidth per line
- `walkLineRanges()` — callback per line with width data, no string allocation

## Foundations

- [Home](https://learn-pretext.com/): Interactive canvas newspaper demo — drag images into a multi-column layout and watch text reflow at 60fps
- [Why Pretext](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/why-pretext.html): The layout-thrashing problem, DOM measurement vs pretext benchmark
- [Getting Started](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/getting-started.html): Tutorial — npm install @chenglou/pretext, first prepare() + layout() call, interactive sandbox

## Core Patterns

- [Accordion](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/accordion.html): Predict text height before rendering to animate expand/collapse without reflow
- [Chat Bubbles](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/bubbles.html): Shrink-wrap message bubbles to their text with walkLineRanges()
- [Masonry](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/masonry.html): Card grid arranged by pre-measured text heights
- [Balanced Text](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/balanced-text.html): Binary-search for even line lengths — a JS alternative to CSS text-wrap: balance
- [The Pipeline](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/pipeline.html): Visualization of what prepare() does internally

## Advanced

- [Rich API](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/rich-api.html): The three API paths (layout, layoutWithLines, layoutNextLine) compared side by side
- [Editorial Layout](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/editorial.html): layoutNextLine() flowing text around draggable obstacles at 60fps
- [Virtualized Lists](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/virtualized.html): 10,000-item virtual scroll with pretext-predicted row heights
- [Canvas Rendering](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/canvas.html): Multiline text on HTML canvas — a measureText alternative with pan/zoom
- [i18n Deep Dive](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/i18n.html): CJK, Arabic, Thai, Hindi, and emoji handling with Unicode line breaking

## Creative

- [Kinetic Typography](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/kinetic.html): Wave text and scatter/gather animation from per-character positions
- [ASCII Art](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/ascii-art.html): Proportional ASCII rendering with pretext-measured widths
- [Text Physics](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/text-physics.html): Physics simulation with text particle collisions
- [ASCII Tanks](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/ascii-tanks.html): Text-based artillery game with real-time character layout
- [Text Rain](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/text-rain.html): Matrix-style falling text with position tracking
- [Text Tetris](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/text-tetris.html): Falling-block gameplay rendered entirely in measured text
- [Word Golf](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/text-flood.html): Dynamic text expansion and flow animation
- [Breaking Spaces](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/breaking-spaces.html): How Unicode line breaking and wrap points behave

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/api-reference.html): Every function documented with interactive try-it blocks
- [Performance Guide](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/performance.html): Benchmarks — hundreds of times faster than getBoundingClientRect, caching strategies
- [Caveats & Recipes](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/caveats.html): system-ui font bug, font matching, production patterns
- [Accessibility](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/accessibility.html): Screen-reader and ARIA patterns for pretext-powered UIs
- [About](https://learn-pretext.com/pages/about.html): Attribution and credits

## Tech stack

- Vanilla TypeScript + Vite (multi-page app), deployed on GitHub Pages
- @chenglou/pretext for text measurement, Shiki for code highlighting
